Incursion.description:
Summons a <style="Summon"><style="Faction_BlackLegion">Bloodletter</style></style> adjacent to an enemy target within range {[range]}. The Bloodletter immediately attacks the target. Keeps summoning Bloodletters up to a max of {[maxSummons]}, as long as the target has not been defeated, is in range and has a free hex adjacent to it. 

Bloodletter’s stats:
<style="Stat_Health">{[summonHp]} Health</style>
<style="Stat_Damage">{[summonDmg]} Damage</style>
